reference: Na ɔmaa n’ani so, na ɔhunuu ɔbarima kwantenni no, kuro no abɔntene so, na akɔkoraa no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛhe na worekorɔ, na ɛhe nso na wofire?

hypothesis: Na wɔwie no, wɔde sika no nkaeɛ ba ɔhene ne yehwa da anim. Na wɔde nneɛma ma ɛwɛ ade fie. Ɔson ne ɔhyɛ afadeɛ ne ho nneɛma no nkoraa ne sika ne dweta nneɛma no.

reference: Na nna bi akyiri no, ɔsane kɔɔ sɛ ɔrekɔhyia no, na ɔmane kɔhwɛɛ gyata funu no, na hwɛ nwowa manyamanya ne ɛwoɔ adɔre gyata no yam.

reference: Na Yefta ka kyerɛɛ Gilead mpanimfoɔ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ mo ara na motane me na mopamm me firii m’agya fie no?
hypothesis: Na after kakyire gi liad panyinfo no se, anya muhana mutae mi na mupa mi free mbɛ gya fie no.

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ sika nkaneadua du sɛdeɛ ne yɛbea teɛ, na ɔde sisii asɔredan no mu, enum wɔ anafoɔ fam, na enum nso wɔ atifi fam.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: M’agya, woanya abue w’ano ama AWURADE a, ɛnneɛ yɛ me sɛdeɛ afiri w’ano no, sɛ AWURADE anya atɔ were ama wo, w’atamfo Amonfoɔ no soɔ yi.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ no see no sɛ: Adɛn na worebisa me din a ɛyɛ nwanwa yi?

reference: Na monnyɛ sɛ mo agyanom ne mo nuanom a wɔfomm AWURADE wɔn agyanom Nyankopɔn, na ɔde wɔn yɛɛ ɔsɛeɛ adeɛ, sɛdeɛ mo ara mohunu yi.
hypothesis: Na hɔn nyasa a hɔn agyanom ne hɔn nnua a wɔfrɔm awurade a hɔn agyanom nye ankɔpɔn. Na wɔde hɔn yɛ ɔsɛyɛadeɛ. Sɛdeɛ moara mu hwene.

reference: Moafa mʼanyame nyinaa ne me ɔsɔfoɔ, na menni hwee bio!
hypothesis: Mbɔfra mbenyin a ne mbrɛ sɔfo na mbenyin hwɛ ebien mu. Dɛ mmarima no bu asɛ, hwɛdeɛ wɔka no yie.

reference: Na ɛso aba pa a ɛfiri aba a asomdwoeɛfoɔ duaa no asomdwoeɛ mu no.
hypothesis: Na ɛso aba paa, efi aba asomdwuafoɔ dua no asomdwu mu no.

reference: Na seesei, moredwene sɛ mobɛfa saa nnipa yi a wɔfiri Yuda ne Yerusalem nkoa.

reference: Na nkurɔfoɔ bebree bɛhyiae, na wɔsisii nsuo aniwa nyinaa ne asutene a ɛsene fa asase no soɔ, kaa sɛ: Adɛn nti na Asiriahene mmra mmɛnya nsuo a ɛdɔɔso?

reference: Wodi wo bɔhyɛ so, na woda wo dɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ daa no adi kyerɛ wɔn a wɔtie wo na wɔn ani gye sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wʼapɛdeɛ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Wo de ubɔhye so, na wɔ da wo dɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ dan no adi sɛ wɔn a wɔtie wo na wɔn anigye sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔ apɛ deɛ nyinaa.

reference: Na yei ne fapem a Salomo too sɛ ɔde resi AWURADE dan no: Ne ntwemu yɛ akane nsusuiɛ no mu basafa aduasa, na ne trɛ nso basafa du.
hypothesis: Na yɛne fa poma salemɔntoos a ɔde resi awurade dan no. Ne ntwi mu yɛ akane nso si yɛ no mu basafa aduasa. Na ne trɛ nso basafa adu .

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ ntweaban mpiakyire mu, na ɔde sensɛnee adum no atifi, na ɔyɛɛ atoaa aba nsɛsoɔ, ɔha, hyehyɛɛ ntweaban no mu.
hypothesis: Na ɔyɛ ntwiaban mpiakyire mu. Na ɔde sensanee adum atifi. Na ɔyɛ atoa aba nsasoɔ ɔha. Hyehyɛ ntwiaban no mu.

reference: Na obiara nnhyɛne AWURADE fie gye asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ mu wɔn a wɔsom no, wɔn na wɔnhyɛne mu, ɛfiri sɛ wɔyɛ kronkron, na ɔman no nyinaa nhwɛ AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ no.
hypothesis: Na obiara nhyɛn ewuradeɛ fi agye asɔfoɔ ne lɛɛfoɔ mu. Wɔn a wɔsɔ no. Wɔn a wɔnhyɛ no mu afiri sɛ wɔyɛ krɔnkrɔn. Na mmaa no nyinaa nhwɛ ewuradeɛ ahyɛdeɛ no.

reference: Wɔkaa Benyamin hyɛɛ mu hyiae tii wɔn ara kɔduruu wɔn asoɛeɛ pamm wɔn kɔsii Gibea ntentensoɔ, owiapueeɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔ ka bɛnyam nhyiamu hyia a yɛtse wɔn ara koduru wɔn aso a ɛyɛ pam wɔn kosi a gibia ntenten soɔ.

reference: Saa nsrahwɛ yi mu na Ahasia ne Yoram kɔhyiaa Nimsi babarima Yehu, a na Awurade ayi no sɛ ɔntwa Ahab fie adedie ntoatoasoɔ no so.
hypothesis: Saa nsrahwɛ mu na no ahasi anyim yɛra kosua a nnim si babɛrima yɛ hu, ana eradze ayi ne nsa otwa ahɛfie adedie ntoatoa so.

reference: Na ɔne ɔman no tuu agyina, na ɔyiyii nnwontofoɔ a wɔto AWURADE dwom yi no ayɛ, ahokeka kronkron mu; na wɔrefiri adie no, wɔdii wɔn a wɔamia no anim, na wɔkaa sɛ: Monna AWURADE ase.
hypothesis: Na ɔne ɔman ne tuo agyina na ɔyi anwontofoɔ a wɔto adwareade dwom no ayɛ ahomeka kurom kurom mu na ɔfiri adie no. Wɔdi wɔn a wɔamia no anim na ɔkansɛ. Mo no ara adeɛ ase.

reference: Na monkum Twam dwan no, na monyɛ mo ho kronkron, na monsiesie mma mo nuanom, na monyɛ sɛdeɛ AWURADE nam Mose so kaeɛ no.
hypothesis: N'amankum twam dwan no, n'amanya mu kɔnkron, n'amansiesie ma mu nnua nom, n'amanya sɛdeɛ wuraade na mmose so kaan no.

reference: Ɛnna Yefta twaa mu kɔɔ Amonfoɔ no soɔ ne wɔn kɔkoeɛ; na AWURADE de wɔn hyɛɛ ne nsa.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɛfita twa mu kɔ Amonfoɔ no soɔ ne wɔn kɔkɔɛ. Na ɛwɔ ade de wɔn hyɛ ne nsa.

reference: Anyame a na wɔwɔ saa aman no so no tumi gyee wɔn nkurɔfoɔ firii me tumi ase?
hypothesis: Nyame a anan wɔ wɔsa aman no so no tumi gye wɔn nkurɔfoɔ firimutumi ase.

reference: Na ɔne ne mfɛfoɔ kɔe, na ɔkɔsuu ne mmabaaberɛ mmepɔ so.
hypothesis: na ne ne fa foɔ kɔɛ na ɔko sunw ne ma ba abrɛ me pɔs.

reference: Na Yehoiada wuo akyiri no, Yuda mmapɔmma ba bɛkotoo ɔhene no.
hypothesis: Na yehwa da wuo akyir no. Yidana ma pɔw ma ba baɛ koto wɔ hwene no.

reference: Na afei, Salomo buee adihɔ mfimfini a ɛwɔ Awurade Asɔredan no anim ano, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, wɔbɛtumi abɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ na wɔahye sradeɛ a ɛfiri asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ mu no wɔ hɔ.
hypothesis: Na afei, salomabue a ɛdi hɔ mfinimfini a ɛwɔ adwadeɛ asɔredan no anim ano sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtwene abɔ ɔhyia fɔdeɛ na wahyɛ sradeɛ a ɛfiri asunduafɔdeɛ no mu wɔ hɔ.

reference: Nso na Benyamin afiri aseɛ abobɔ Israel mmarima no akunkum wɔn mu nnipa bɛyɛ aduasa, na wɔse: Ka ara na yɛaka wɔn aguo wɔ yɛn anim sɛ kane ko no mu.
hypothesis: Nsona bɛyɛ mmɛfra ase abobɔ israeɛ mmarima no akunkum wɔn mu nnipa bɛyɛ aduasa. Na wɔsɛ kan a wɔaka no agu wɔn anim sɛ kane kun no mu.

reference: Saa nti, ɛnam sɛ wɔagya yɛn ne home mu kɔ ho bɔhyɛ nti, momma yɛnsuro, na mo mu biara anyɛ sɛ waka akyi.
hypothesis: Sɛnti, ɛnam sɛ wɔagya ahuhum mu, kɔɔ ho bɔhyentie, wɔmaye nsoro, na mu mu biara a nyɛ sɛ wɔaka akyire.

reference: Sohwɛfoɔ a na wɔhyɛ wɔn ase no ne Yehiel, Asasia, Nahat, Asahel, Yerimot, Yosabad, Eliel, Ismakia, Mahat ne Benaia.
hypothesis: Sotwafoɔ a wɔahyɛ wɔn asene ne Yehel, Asasia, Nahat, Asahel, Yerimot, Yerobat, Eliel, Ismakia, Mahat ne Benaya.

reference: Ɛnna Debora ka kyerɛɛ Barak sɛ: Sɔre, na ɛnnɛ ne da a AWURADE de Sisera ahyɛ wo nsa.
hypothesis: Ɛna dabrɔ a kakyere bags a sɔre. Na n'ani da a ɛra de de sisɛre ahyɛ wɔn nsa.

reference: Afe a ɛdi ɛkan wɔ bosome a ɛdi ɛkan mu no, ɔhene Nebukadnessar frɛɛ Yehoiakyin sɛ ɔmmra Babilonia.
hypothesis: Afe a edi kan wɔ bosom a edi kan mu no, ɔhene ne bukani za frayeɛ kwakye nsɛ ɔmmura babilonia.

reference: Na Yerusalemfoɔ de ne ba kumaa Ahasia sii hene n’ananmu, ɛfiri sɛ ne mma mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa, afomfafoɔ asafo a wɔne Arabfoɔ no baa nsra mu no kunkumm wɔn.
hypothesis: Na Yerusalemfoɔ de ne ba kumaa ahaesiease henna n'anan mu. Efisɛ ne mma mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa afunafafoɔ asafoɔ a wɔne arɛbfoɔ no ba a nsraanom kunukun wɔn.

reference: Nanso ɔyɛ maa no no, Hesekia anhyɛ no ananmu sɛdeɛ yie a ɔyɛ maa no no teɛ, na mmom n’akoma yɛɛ ahantan, na AWURADE abufuo baa ɔno ne Yuda ne Yerusalem so.
hypothesis: Nanso ɔyɛ maa no no, kɛsekee a anhyɛ no anam mu sɛdeɛ yie a ɔyɛ maa no no teɛ. Nam mu no, akomaa yɛ ahantan. Na nwuradeɛ abofra baako no ne yuda ne Yerusalem so.

reference: Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Benyamin mmarima a wɔda so hwehwɛ yerenom no sɛ, “Monkɔtɛ wɔ bobe nturo no mu.
hypothesis: Wɔ kakyɛ benyam mmarima a wɔde asɔhwehwɛ ayira ne nsa mu nkwadaa wɔ bobe nturo no mu.

reference: Saa ɛberɛ no ara na Asa ahyɛ aseɛ rehyɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ no bi so.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wobɛtumi aka sɛ: Medɔ wo, na w’akoma nni me ho yi?
hypothesis: Na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ ɛbɛyɛde na wobe tumi aka sɛ medɔw. Na wakoma anim hwene.

reference: Na Hilkia bua see Ɔtwerɛfoɔ Safan sɛ: Mmara nwoma no na mahu no AWURADE fie yi.
hypothesis: Nahyɛ ahyia aboa asi, ɔtwerɛfoɔ sɛ fansɛɛ. Mberahoma no mu na mɛhu na ɛwurade fie yi.

reference: Na ɔnantee Israel ahemfo kwan so, sɛdeɛ Ahab fie yɛeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Ahab babaa yɛ ne yere, na ɔyɛɛ AWURADE ani so bɔne.
hypothesis: Na ɔnante Israafo kwan so sɛdeɛ ahabfu yie yɛyɛ no. Afrisɛ ahababa yɛ ne yere. Na ɔyɛ nwuradeɛ ne so bɔ ne .

reference: Montie me, na monnyaa saa nneduafoɔ a wɔwɔ mo nsam no, ɛfiri sɛ, wɔyɛ mo ankasa mo abusuafoɔ.
hypothesis: Muntieme, na munyɛ saa ne dua foɔ a wɔwɔ mu nsam no afisɛɛ, wɔyɛ mankasa mubu sua foɔ.

reference: Na ɔde n’ahoɔden nyinaa kuntunii, na efie no dwiri guu asafohene no ne nnipa a wɔwɔ mu no nyinaa so.
hypothesis: Na ɔde n'ahoɔden nyinaa kuntun yi. Na efie no dwere gu asafo hwene no ne nnipa a wɔwɔ mu no nyinaa so.

reference: Ɛnna ɔsɔfoɔ no penee soɔ, na ɔfaa asɔfotadeɛ ne abusua ahoni ne ohoni a wɔasene no, na ɔde kɔɔ ɛdɔm no mu.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔsɔfoɔ no pene soɔ. Na ɔfasɔfotaadeɛ ne abusua honi ne ohuonia a wasene no, na ɔde kɔ ɛdɔm no mu.

reference: Enti na atwerɛ no se: Onyankopɔn si ahantanfoɔ kwan.
hypothesis: Wɔn ti na atwerefoɔ no si, "ɔnye akopɔnso a hantanfoɔ kwan hyɛ".

reference: Nebukadnessar faa ademudeɛ a ɛwɔ Awurade Asɔredan no mu bi, de kɔguu nʼahemfie wɔ Babilonia.
hypothesis: na abuka ne zafa adimudie a ɛwɔ adwadie asɔe dan no mu bi. dikogu n'ahimfie wɔ babilonia.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ ne teaseɛnamkafoɔ no sɛ: Dane w’ani na fa me firi ɛdɔm yi mu, na mapira.
hypothesis: Naa ɔka kyerɛ a n'akyi ase a ɛnam kafoɔ no sɛ, dan wɔ ani, na fami firi ɛdɔm yi mu. Na mbɛpra.

reference: Na anwanwadeɛ a yɛn agyanom kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ yɛn no nso wɔ he?
hypothesis: Nawɔn adeɛ a wɔregye anom kaa ho asɛm kyerɛeɛ no nso wɔ hɛn.

reference: Na ɛdan a ɛkorɔn kɔ soro yi, obiara a ɔtwam ho no ho bɛdwiri no na waka sɛ: Ɛnam deɛn so nti na AWURADE ayɛ asase yi ne efie yi saa?
hypothesis: Na dan a korɔ kɔ soro yi, obiara a otwam ho no ho bɛdwere no. Na wɔakasɛ, namden a nso tena awuradeɛ a ayɛ asaase ne efie yi saa.

reference: Na n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu no, ɔsomaa n’asafohene Ben-hail ne Obadia ne Sakaria ne Netanel ne Mikaia sɛ wɔnkɔ nkɔkyerɛkyerɛ Yuda nkuro mu.
hypothesis: Na n'ahenia afie a ɛtɔ so mmeɛnsa mu no, ɔsoma a n'asafo he ne Ben Hale ne Obadiya Nsakaria ne Natanael ne Michael Asê. Wɔn kɔnkɔ kyerɛkyerɛ yi dan kuro mu.

reference: Na Lewifoɔ a wɔfiri Kohatfoɔ mma mu ne Korafoɔ mma mu no sɔree sɛ wɔde ɛnne kɛseɛ pa ara reyi AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no ayɛ.
hypothesis: N'aleewifoɔ a wɔfiri kohaadfoɔ mmaa mu ne koorafoɔ mmaa mu no sɔre resɛ, wɔde ne kɛseɛ pa ara reyi awuradeɛ Israel nyankopɔ ayɛ.

reference: Na Yosia firii deɛ ɔwɔ mu, maa nnwammaa ne mmirekyie mma ɔpeduasa ne anantwinini mpem mmiɛnsa sɛ nnipa no Twam Afahyɛ afɔrebɔdeɛ.

reference: Na Yefta kɔkaa ne nsɛm nyinaa AWURADE anim wɔ Mispa.
hypothesis: Na ayɛ fitaa kɔkan a ne nsam nyinaa awie adeɛ anim wɔ mespa.

reference: Ɔbaa no agya no kaa sɛ, “Medwenee sɛ na wotan no, ɛno enti, mede no ama ɔbarima a na ɔdi wʼanan ase wɔ mo ayeforɔhyia mu no.
hypothesis: Ɔbaa no agya no kaa sɛ, dɔnku ne sɛ n’awotan no, ɛno nti, maa du no ama ɔbarima a na ɔdi wɔn nan ase wɔ wɔ ayefohyia mu no.

reference: Wɔde sika a Lewifoɔ a wɔsom sɛ aponoanohwɛfoɔ agyegye wɔ Onyankopɔn Asɔredan no ho maa ɔsɔfopanin Hilkia.

reference: Nnipa a wɔyɛɛ bɔne na wɔtete hwe wuwuu wɔ ɛserɛ so no.
hypothesis: Nnipa wɔyɛ abɔne no wɔtete fiwu wɔ ɛsrɛ so no.

reference: Na wo ara, wo nko ara na wonim nnipa mma akoma mu, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na wɔasuro woɔ, na woanante w’akwan soɔ nna a wɔde bɛtena asase a wode maa yɛn agyanom no soɔ no nyinaa.
hypothesis: Na wɔara wɔn ko ara na wɔnim nnipa ma akoma mu. Deɛ ɛbɛyɛ no ara wɔasua awoɔ na wɔara no nto wɔakɔ asoɔ na wɔde bɛtena asase a wɔde maa yɛn agya no so nyinaa.

reference: Na ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Sei na monyɛ wɔ AWURADE ho suro mu, nokorɛ ne mo akoma mu.
hypothesis: Na ɔhyerɛ wɔn nse sɛ na wɔnye wɔn ade ho soro mu na okura ne mu akonnwa.

reference: Na afei masoma ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a ɔwɔ nhunumu a ɔne Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: N'afee, masomero ɔbarima nyansafoɔ a wɔne huram abien.

reference: Mɛma wɔayɛ nsɛsodeɛ ne ohoni a wɔagu de ahyɛ me babarima animuonyam.
hypothesis: Mmarima a wɔyɛ nsasidie ne ohonin a woegu di ahyɛ me ba barima animnyam.

reference: Na Yerusalem nso, Yehosafat de Lewifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne Israel agyanom atitire no mu binom sisii AWURADE atemmuo ne asennie so.
hypothesis: Na Yerusalem so, Yehosafat dilawifoɔ ne asɔfoɔ ne yisrael gya no mu tetooni binom sisi. Nwuradeɛ atɛ mo ne asɛnnniɛ so.

reference: “Merebrɛ wo odwumfoɔ a ne nsa ano adwuma yɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no Huram-Abi.
hypothesis: Mbree wɔ odwofoɔ a ne nsa ɛne adwuma yɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no huram abe.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ Aaron mma, asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔmmɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ wɔ AWURADE afɔrebukyia no so.
hypothesis: Na ɔka kyerɛ nnwoma. Asɔfoɔ no, sɛ wɔhyia afadeɛ wɔ nwuradeɛ afa rebu kyi ano so.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte dɛwura kyerɛ suase. Rama ne bɛɛtɔ ntam efiri bepɔ so. Na sraayɛfoɔ no foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmuwa atɛn.

reference: Na ɛpo no si wɔn so ɔsoro, na wɔn akyiri nyinaa wɔ emu fam.
hypothesis: Nɛpo no si wɔn so ɔsoro. Na wɔn akyi nyinaa wɔ ɛmu fa .

reference: Ɛnna ɔhene no frɛɛ Ɔpanin Yehoiada, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Adɛn nti na womma Lewifoɔ no nnye Yuda ne Yerusalem toɔ a AWURADE akoa Mose ne Israel badwa no hyɛ maa adanseɛ ntomadan no?
hypothesis: Ana ahene no frɛ ɔpanin yehuada na ɔkakyerɛ anosɛm. Ada yi tena wɔn alewijifoɔ no nye Yudani, Yerusalem, toa a ɛwura ade akɔn mu osi. Ne Israa a ɛbɛdwa hyɛ maa adan seɛ ntomadan no.

reference: Na Gileadni Yefta yɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ nnam, nanso ɔyɛ ɔbaa dwamamfoɔ bi ba, na Gilead na ɔwoo Yefta.
hypothesis: Na Gilead ne yɛfuta yi ɔbarima a ɔnam. Na aso ɔyɛ ɔbaa adwam afuo bi ba. Na Gilead na ɔwɔ yɛfuta yi.

reference: Asɔrefie sie no mfitiaseɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔata so mmienu te mmeɛnsa. Asɔrefie sie no mfiti aseɛ.

reference: Na Gideon hunuu sɛ ɛyɛ AWURADE bɔfoɔ no, Gideon kaa sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn!
hypothesis: Na Gideon huru sɛɛ a wɔadobɔfoɔ no, Gideon kaa sɛ, awɔ adenya nkɔ pon.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Amonfoɔ to hyɛɛ Israelfoɔ so, Gilead mpanimfoɔ soma kɔfaa Yefta firii Tob asase so baeɛ.
hypothesis: Ebere a ammorfoɔ to hyɛ esuafoɔ so, giliadepenifoɔ suma, kɔfayɛfuta, fritob, ataasisoba.

reference: Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no, ɛsono wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn duaduaa Yuda nyinaa mu nkuro a ɛyɛ den no mu no.
hypothesis: Yie no ne wɔn a wɔsom ɔhene no, ɛso wɔn a ɔhene de wɔn ho duadua yɛ ɛwuda nyinaa mu nkuro a ɛyɛ den no mu no.

reference: Na Sisera maa wɔkɔpae hyiahyiaa ne nteaseɛnam a ɛyɛ dadeɛ nteaseɛnam ahankron no nyinaa ne ɔman a wɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi Haroset-hagoyim baa Kison nsunoa.
hypothesis: Na sesaar ama ɔkɔ pae hyehyɛ a ne nteaseɛ na ma ɛyɛ dadea nteaseɛ na ma ahankor ne nyinaa ne ɔman a ɔka ne ho nyinaa de firi. Ha hwɛ set ha goe mu, baake so nsu no ara.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Nara ade kɛtse dɛ Israefoɔ sɛ; Misrmfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidɔnfoɔ, Amalekyifoɔ ne Moamfoɔ a nsam so .

reference: Ɔno deɛ, honam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn na ɔne yɛn wɔ hɔ, sɛ ɔbɛboa yɛn na wako yɛn ko ama yɛn.
hypothesis: Ɔno deɛ, honam nsa na ɛne no wɔ hɔ, na yɛn deɛ, nwuradeɛ nyangopɔ na ɔne no yɛn wɔ hɔ. Sɛ ɔbɛboa yɛn, na akonwa kɔn ama yɛn.

reference: Na Onyankopɔn yɛɛ saa, anadwo no, na enwi no nko woe, na fam hɔ nyinaa, obosuo tɔ guu hɔ.
hypothesis: Na anyin akopɔ ɛresa, anadwe no, na nwiri no nko wɔe, na famu hɔ nyinaa obosuo togu hɔ.

reference: Na ɔsomaa abɔfoɔ maa wɔkɔɔ Aser ne Sebulon ne Naftali, na wɔforo ba bɛhyiaa no.
hypothesis: Na ɔsom abɔfoɔ ma ɔkɔɔ asa ne sɛ ɔbɔ ne naftali. Na ɔreforo ba besi ano.

reference: Na ɔte Debora kyiresua ase, Rama ne Betel ntam, Efraim bepɔ so; na Israelfoɔ foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmu wɔn atɛn.
hypothesis: Nɔɔte dɛwura kyerɛ suase. Rama ne bɛɛtɔ ntam efiri bepɔ so. Na sraayɛfoɔ no foro ba ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmuwa atɛn.

reference: Na hwɛ, na Sisera da hɔ awu, na pɛɛwa no tua n’asontorɔ mu.
hypothesis: Ɛna hyɛ, na sɛ ɛsɛɛ adahuawu na pɛɛwa no tia na so ntoro mu.

reference: Ɛnna ɔman no de wɔn ho too Yudahene Hesekia nsɛm no soɔ.
hypothesis: na ɔman no de wɔn ho tow yuda hɛn hezekiya nsam no so.

reference: Kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a wɔde dii dwuma no dodoɔ enti, wɔantumi anhunu emu duru ano.
hypothesis: Kɔɔber mfrafra yɛ a wɔde di dwuma no dodoɔ nti. Wɔn tumi ehu emu dro ano.

reference: Asɔredan a merebɛsi no kɛseɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛbɛyɛ enti, nnua bebree ho bɛhia me.
hypothesis: Asɔredan a wɔbesi no kɛseɛ ne ne fɛ a ɛbɛyɛ nti. Nnua bebree ho behian me.

reference: Ɛnna wɔfaa safoa de hiniiɛ, na hwɛ, na wɔn wura da fam awu.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔfasafo ade hene yi na hwɛ. Na wɔn wura da famu awo.

reference: Na wɔhwiee sika a wɔhunuu no AWURADE fie no guu hɔ, na wɔde hyɛɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.
hypothesis: Na wɔhwie sika a wɔnhunu no, nwurade fie no gu hɔ. Na wɔde hyɛ ahwɛfoɔ no ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma no nsa.

reference: Na AWURADE bɔfoɔ yii ne ho kyerɛɛ ɔbaa no, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Hwɛ, woyɛ obonini na wonwo, nanso wobɛnyinsɛn awo ɔbabarima.
hypothesis: Na eradzobɔfoɔ yi ne ho twerɛ ɔbaa no. Na ɔka kyerɛ no sɛ, hwɛ ɔyɛ obɔni na wɔn wɔ, na nsu benyinsee wɔn ɔba barima.

reference: Na Amorifoɔ hyeɛ firi Akrabim aforoeɛ, ɛfiri Sela rekorɔ no.
hypothesis: Nammoyifoɔ ahyia firi akraba mu aforiɛ. Efiri cella rekɔ no.

reference: Na ɔne wɔn tenaa Nyankopɔn fie, huntaa mfeɛ nsia.
hypothesis: Na wɔne wɔn tsena nyahopɔmfie kunta efie nsia.

reference: Mfeɛ dunwɔtwe na wɔdii Israelfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yordan agya, Amorifoɔ asase soɔ wɔ Gilead no nyinaa soɔ.
hypothesis: Mfidie no wɔatwe no a wɔde israa a wɔwɔ yɔda no gya. Amoyifoɔ asase soɔ wɔ giliad no nyinaa so.

reference: Enti, Awurade abufuo baa ɔno, Yuda ne Yerusalem nyinaa so.
hypothesis: Nti, erɛde ebufo baa ɔno, Yuda ne Yerusalem nyinaa so.

reference: Ɔdaa hɔ ara kɔsii sɛ anim teteeɛ.
hypothesis: Wɔ da kuro no abɔnten kɛseɛ so, na obiara anfoɔ hɔn anko fie akɔso hɔ hɔhoro.

reference: Me nuanom monhwɛ yie na mo mu bi annya akoma bɔne a ɔrennye Onyankopɔn nni na ɛbɛma watwe ne ho afiri Onyankopɔn teasefoɔ no ho.
hypothesis: Menua no, ɔmo nhwɛ yie na ɔmo mu bi anya akomabɔnyi a ɔnyi wɔ nyakopɔn nyi. Na ɔbɛma watwe ne ho afiri wɔ nyakopɔn tiri asofoɔ no ho.

reference: Momfa wɔn sɛ nhwɛsoɔ wɔ wɔn boasetɔ ne tumi a wɔtumi de tenaa amanehunu mu no.
hypothesis: Mmonfa wɔn nse, nhwesoɔ wɔ wɔn bo asetɔ. Ne tume a wɔtum di tena amanee horo mu no.

reference: Ɛnna Amasia bisaa Nyankopɔn nipa no sɛ: Na ɛdeɛn na yɛnyɛ dwetikɛseɛ ɔha a mede ama Israel asafo no?
hypothesis: Ɛna amaa esi bi saa nyankopuu nipa no sɛ, deɛ adeɛ yɛn yɛ gyata kɛseɛ ɔha mmɛde ama Israɛli asaafo no.

reference: Israelfoɔ no somm Moabhene Eglon mfirinhyia dunwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Israfo no so muabene eguro mfisie adum wɔtwe.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ sɛ: Misraimfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidonfoɔ, Amalekfoɔ ne Maonfoɔ anhyɛ mo so!
hypothesis: Nara ade kɛtse dɛ Israefoɔ sɛ; Misrmfoɔ, Amorifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Filistifoɔ, Sidɔnfoɔ, Amalekyifoɔ ne Moamfoɔ a nsam so .

reference: Mprɛnsa ni a woasisi me, na wonkyerɛɛ me adekodeɛ a w’ahoɔden kɛseɛ yi wɔ mu.
hypothesis: Mperɛsɛni a wɔasisi me na wɔn kyerɛ mi adekodeɛ a wɔn ho aden kɛseɛ yi wom.

reference: Ɛda bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi Betlehem a ɛwɔ Yuda baa fie sɛ ne mpena.
hypothesis: Ɛda bi, ɔde ɔbaa bi firi bɛtchelaham a ɛwɔ Yuda ba afie sɛ ne mpona.

reference: Na wɔn mma deɛ, wankum wɔn, sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ no mmara no mu, Mose nwoma mu no a AWURADE hyɛɛ sɛ: Agyanom nnwu, mma nti, na mma nso nnwu, agyanom nti, na onipa no ara bɔne nti na wɔmma no nwuo.
hypothesis: Na wɔn mma deɛ, wɔnko wɔn. Sɛdeɛ watwerɛ no mbra no mu, wɔnsa wɔn mma mu no a ɛwura de reseresɛ. Ɛgya no mu wɔ mma no ti. Na mma nso mmu ɛgya no mu ti. Na onipa no ara abɔ ne ti na wɔn mma no mu.

reference: Na wɔkɔfrɛɛ Samson firii apokyerɛfoɔ fie bae, na ɔgoroo wɔn anim, na wɔde no gyinaa adum no ntam.
hypothesis: Na wɔkɔ frɛ samsen firi abɔtwerɛfoɔ fie baa. Na wɔregoro wɔn anim. Na wɔde no gyina adum no ntam.

reference: Ɛnna AWURADE abufuo dɛre tiaa Israel, na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛɛ Mesopotamia hene Kusan-risataim nsa, na Israelfoɔ som Kusan-risataim mfirinhyia nwɔtwe.
hypothesis: Ɛna dɛɛbuofoɔ dɛɛte a Israɛl na ɔtɔn wɔn hyɛn mesopotamia. Hɛn ekusam resa tem nsa. Na Israɛl fɔwɔ no som kusa resa tem mfinhyia wɔ twɛn.

reference: Na sɛ mobisa koraa nso a, mo nsa renka, ɛfiri sɛ, mowɔ adwemmɔne.
hypothesis: na sɛ mo bisakora nso a mo nsa nka efisɛ, mo wɔ adwommbɔni.

reference: Na ɔsanee sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yadeɛ Yesreel afiri pira a ɔne Siriahene Hasael reko no, wɔpirapiraa no Rama no mu.
hypothesis: Nsane yi sɛ ɔrekɔsa ne ho yɛ adeɛ. Izrel. Afir pra a ɔne Syria hwene asɔre kɔ no. Wɔpirapira no rama no mu.

reference: Ɛnna Salomo boaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo no atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agyanom mmapɔmma no ano bɛhyiaa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro a ɛne Sion no mu aba.
hypothesis: Ɛna Salomon bo a, Izraai mpanimfoɔ ne musuakuo ne atitire ne Izraai foɔ mu agyanom ma pɔɔma n'ano behyia Yerusalem. Sɛ wɔɔkɔ fɔ ewura adeɛ apɔmu adaka no afiri dawidi kuro a, ɛne seyo no mu aba.

reference: Enti Lewifoɔ no siesiee wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ, Aaron mma no deɛ.
hypothesis: Ntilewifoɔ no siesie wɔn ara wɔn deɛ ne asɔfoɔ nneɛma no deɛ.

reference: Na Samson ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wɔde nhomamono nson a ɛnwoeɛ kyekyere me a, ɛnneɛ mɛhodwo, na mayɛ sɛ onipa biara.
hypothesis: Na samson kaa kyerɛ no sɛ, sɛ wɔde nhomamono nso a ɛhwɛ ɛkyerɛkyerɛmia na ɛmahɔ dwo. Nnam ayɛ sɛw nnipa biara.

reference: Na merenkɔ so mentwe Israel nan mfiri asase a mahyɛ ama wɔn agyanom no so: Hwɛ ara nko na wɔnhwɛ nyɛ adeɛ a mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa, Mose nsa ano mmara ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atemmudeɛ nyinaa.
hypothesis: Namenkɔ so mentwe Israel nan mfiri asaase amahyam wɔ egya no mu so. Hweara nko na wɔn nhwiren yɛ adeɛ a mahyɛ wɔn no nyinaa. Mo nsɛn nsa ano mbra ne ahyɛdeɛ ne atɛbudeɛ nyinaa.

reference: Na wɔsɔre yiyii afɔrebukyia a ɛwowɔ Yerusalem no, na aduhwamhyeɛ afɔrebukyia no nyinaa nso wɔyiyii, na wɔkɔto guu asuwa Kidron mu.
hypothesis: Na wɔsɔreyi afaribukyia a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no. Na duhwamhyia afaribukyia no nyinaa nso wɔreyi. Na wɔkɔ togu esua ka dorɔm.

reference: Salomo kan ahɔhoɔ dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Israel asase so, te sɛ deɛ nʼagya kenkanee nnipa no.
hypothesis: Salomokan ahɔhwa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Idris Asase so te sɛ deɛ Niger kan a yɛ nipa no.

reference: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Sɛ wode me tirinwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛ nson de fra ntomaban nwono a.
hypothesis: na ɔka kyerɛ nɔseɛ. Sɛ ɔde mitri nwi mpɛsɛmpɛsɛn so ɖe fra ntoma ban eŋu na.

reference: Mʼabusua na ɛyɛ mmerɛ koraa wɔ Manase abusuakuo mu na me na mesua koraa wɔ me fiefoɔ nyinaa mu.
hypothesis: Mbusua na ɛyɛ mbrɛ koraa wɔ manaase ebusua kuomu. Na mmena m'esua koraa wɔ m'efi efuɔ nyinaa.

reference: Na Nebukadnessar yii Yehoiakyin wɔfa Sedekia, sɛ ɔnni ɔhene wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Na nebuka ne dza yie yehwa te wɔfa sɛdeke a, sɛ wɔn ani ɔhene wɔ yuda ne Yerusalem.

reference: Na asase no sofoɔ no faa Yosia ba Yehoahas sii no hene n’agya ananmu Yerusalem.
hypothesis: Na asase no so foɔ no fa, yɛosi aba, yɛhu aha ase no, hyɛn agya anan mu, Yerusalem.

reference: Enti, wɔde anigyeɛ kamfoo Awurade, na wɔkoto sɔreeɛ.
hypothesis: Nti, wɔde anigyeɛ kanfo erade na wɔkoto sɔre.

reference: Na ɛno akyiri no ɛbaa Yoas akoma mu sɛ ɔbɛsiesie AWURADE fie no foforɔ.
hypothesis: Na nnoɔ ekyir no, ɛbaa yi wɔ asa kumam sɛ wɔbesiesie nwuradi fi no foforɔ.

reference: Na ɔyɛɛ deɛ ɛtene AWURADE ani so, sɛdeɛ n’agya Usia yɛeɛ no ara.
hypothesis: Na ɔyɛ adeɛ tena ɛwura adeɛ no so. Sɛdeɛ n'egya yi si ayɛ no ara.

reference: Ɛnna ɔbarima Lewini a ɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdii no awuo no kunu no buaa sɛ: Meduruu Gibea a ɛyɛ Benyamin deɛ no mu, me ne me mpena no, na yɛbɛdaa hɔ.
hypothesis: Ɛna ɔbarima leweneɛ a wɔyɛ ɔbaa a wɔdi ne awuo ne kunu no boaase. Mmaduorɔgu beaeɛ bɛn mɛn deɛ no mu. Mmɛnne mmɛmpena no. Na yɛbɛda ahɔ.

reference: Na asase no so dwoo mfeɛ aduanan.
hypothesis: Na asase no nso dzo nfie adi anan.

reference: Nsuo pa ne nsuo a ɛyɛ nkyenenkyene bɛtumi afiri asutire baako mu aba?
hypothesis: nsuopa ne nsu a ɛyɛ nkyerɛnkyerɛn bɛtumi afidie sotere baako mu abawon.

reference: Na ɔfaa asɔfoɔ no ho abufuo no, kwata fifirii ne moma so, asɔfoɔ no anim, AWURADE fie hɔ, aduhwamhyeɛbukyia no ho.
hypothesis: Na ɔfa a asɔfoɔ no ho abɔfoɔ no, nkwataa firi ne moma so. Asɔfoɔ no anim, nwura de fi hɔ. Adwuma nhyia abɔ etia no ho.

reference: Afei, wɔfaa nnadeɛ adwumfoɔ maa wɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔbere mfrafraeɛ yɛɛ Awurade Asɔredan no ho nneɛma.
hypothesis: Afe wɔ fɔ anadeɛ dwumfoɔ ma wɔde nnadeɛ ne kɔɔbɛn mfrafra yie awadeɛ asɔredan no ho nneɛma.

reference: Na Hesekia kaa sɛ: Afei moadwira mo ho ama AWURADE, montwe mpini, na momfa okum afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ mmra AWURADE fie.
hypothesis: Na Hezekiya aka ase yi, afei mu adwira mu ho ama awurade. Mo ntwene pono, na mo mfoa okum afɔdeɛ ne aseda afɔdeɛ mera awurade fie.

reference: Na wɔretwentwɛn wɔn nan aseɛ no, Ehud dwanee, na ɔbɛsianee ahoni no ho, na ɔdwane baa Seira.
hypothesis: Na wɔatwenkyɛn wɔn nan aseɛ no. Ewu dwane. Na obi sɛn ahoni no ho. Na odwane ba siera.

reference: Enti monyi efi ne bɔne nyinaa nto ntwene, na momfa ɔdwoɔ nnye asɛm a wɔatɛ no mo mu a ɛbɛtumi agye mo kra no.
hypothesis: Ntmonyi efi ne bɔnye nyinaa ntondwen, na mmomfa ɔdzeɔ nye asɛm a wata nnɔmmɔ mu a ebetumi agye mmɔkra ano.

reference: Na Huram yɛɛ nsenaa ne sesa adeɛ ne nkoraa no nso.

reference: Na nteaseɛnam so asafohene no hunuu Yehosafat no, wɔkaa sɛ: Israel hene no nie!
hypothesis: Nanteaseanam so asafo hee no ho Yehosafatu wɔkansɛ Israel hee no nie.

reference: Na mosu frɛɛ me no, megyee mo firii wɔn nsam.
hypothesis: Na mu nso frem no, mejjɛ mu firi wɔn nsam.

reference: Ɛberɛ a Asaria ne asɔfoɔ a aka no hunuu kwata no, wɔpiapiaa no firii hɔ.
hypothesis: Bree a asa adi a asɔfo a aka no ho nu kata no. wɔrepirepire no firi hɔ.

reference: Ɔhene Salomo yii wɔn mu ahanu aduonum maa wɔkɔhwɛɛ ne nkɔsoɔnnwuma so.
hypothesis: Ɔhene salome yi wɔn mu aheneɛ die nnwom ma ɔrehwɛ ne nkosow onwum ase.

reference: Agyanom atitire a wɔwɔ mmarima akofoɔ no mu no nyinaa ano si mpennu ahansia.
hypothesis: Gya no mu atitiri a wɔwɔ mmarima akɔfoɔ no mu no nyinaa anosi mpinu ahensia.

reference: Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Gideon sɛ: Mmarima ahasa a wɔtafereeɛ no na mede bɛgye mo, na mede Midian mahyɛ wo nsa, na ma wɔn a aka no mu biara nkɔ ne tenabea.
hypothesis: Nea wɔde kakyire giidion so a mmarima aha ase a wɔta fire no na nea ɛde bɛgye mu. Na nea ɛde mediɛm asɔ wɔn nsa. Na ma wɔn a aka no mu biara nkɔ ne tenabea.
